description: Watch a TLS certificate: whether it is valid, who issued it, and how many days remain before it expires. This is about the certificate, not about the site being reachable - pair it with create_http_monitor when you want both. Note that such a monitor carries two independent states, one for reachability and one for expiry, so a certificate can be days from expiring while the check still reads up.

name.description: Label shown in the dashboard and in alerts, up to 50 characters. Something recognisable months later beats the bare hostname.

url.description: Domain whose certificate to inspect, for example example.com. No scheme, no path.

name: create_ssl_monitor

id.description: Monitor id, used by every other tool.

isActive.description: False while the monitor is paused.

statusSummary.description: Current state, for example GOOD or ERROR.
